description.value: Ole Chicken is a Korean pub situated on the second floor at 1256 Robson Street in downtown Vancouver, specializing in Korean fried chicken served in a variety of sauces alongside traditional anju share plates and soups. The space has a lively pub atmosphere with music, drinks, and a commissary kitchen available for rent. It sits on one of Vancouver's busiest pedestrian corridors, making it a convenient urban stop for cyclists coming in off the Robson Street corridor.
